claims.claim: Intersect requests $298,250, stated as 1,193,000 ADA, to support Technical Steering Committee activities for 12 months.
The budget is allocated as 256,000 ADA for WP1, 832,000 ADA for WP2, and 105,000 ADA for WP3, totaling 1,193,000 ADA.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
All expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds will be returned to the Cardano treasury.
The proposal states that independent audits and assurance will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews of deliverables, controls, spend validation, and milestone evidence.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not at time of submission, alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

The Technical Steering Committee has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.

Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses and multi-party authorization rules involving Intersect admins, Intersect leadership, and six oversight entities.
The proposal claims the TSC work supports Cardano's 2030 strategy pillars, including uptime, DRep participation, adoption, community growth, and ecosystem resilience.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of Intersect Technical Steering Committee support, provides work-package allocations, names governance and smart-contract administration mechanisms, and cites external references for voting, audits, NCL, and treasury tooling, but many impact and strategic-alignment claims remain asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
